global: Vertical JOURNEY_LADDER (magnitude-ladder) Short: a persistent vertical magnitude ruler on the left edge with a fixed red pointer; one 'MAGNITUDE n' header per step; a new stick-figure / globe / TV vignette per step on white; red marks (zigzag, circles, hatching) for emphasis; typeset headers, hand-lettered captions.
motion: Titles swap on the first frame of a step, then the ruler scrolls the pointer over 7-9 f (ease-in-out); one 6-f linear cross-dissolve to a zoomed-out ruler; red marks drawn on in 7-9 f; captions typed; a 135-f continuous accelerating ruler scroll at the end (3k -> 12.9k px/frame). Camera essentially still.
continuity: The ruler and pointer persist across every step and only the scale moves; each step replaces the right-side vignette; the cracked globe persists from MAGNITUDE 11 to 18; never reuse the TV anchor with side hair buns or the moon-sized battle-station sphere (third-party film references).
